snippet.title: So I Made Matilda Chapter 2...
snippet.description:
MATILDA 2 is finally out.

Chapter 2 continues directly after the first game. Your family is gone, the forest is waiting, and something is hunting you in the dark.

Play MATILDA 2 here: https://redcap-games.itch.io/matilda-2
